svg.title: Babul arrives with the paper result after the corrected treatment is prepared.
svg.desc: Babul offers a sealed paper envelope from the waterproof tube while Ananya finishes preparing the corrected treatment. The paper now confirms the source instead of delaying care.
svg.text: Page 30, panel 4 · Doorway medium shot as Babul arrives with the paper result

text.tspan: The paper result arrives safely by hand after the
linked result has already changed care.
